glosses: footprint (impression of the foot in a soft substance)
fingerprint (unique natural pattern of ridges on the tips of the fingers; marks left by these)

examples.text: Hay huellas de gato encima de la mesa.
examples.en: There are footprints of a cat on the table.

examples.text: Había huellas de pingüinos en la arena.
examples.en: There were penguin footprints in the sand.

examples.text: Tus huellas dactilares están en el cuchillo.
examples.en: Your fingerprints are on the knife.
